result.finding: A single custom bridge network 'photoalbum-network' is defined in docker-compose.yml. Both services (oracle-db and photoalbum-java-app) are attached to this network, enabling DNS-based inter-service communication. The application references Oracle DB by hostname 'oracle-db' in the JDBC URL.
evidence: docker-compose.yml top-level networks: photoalbum-network with driver: bridge
Both services (oracle-db, photoalbum-java-app) connected to photoalbum-network
Application JDBC URL uses hostname-based resolution: jdbc:oracle:thin:@oracle-db:1521/FREEPDB1
Ports exposed to host: 8080:8080 (app), 1521:1521 (Oracle DB) — accessible from host machine
No Kubernetes NetworkPolicy or host/overlay networking used
